Kencangkan quadriceps dulu; angkat hanya bila lutut tetap lurus (tanpa lag)

先收紧股四头肌；只有膝关节能保持伸直（无滞后）时才抬腿

keterangan.id:
**Heel slide**
Geser tumit ke arah bokong sebatas toleransi; patuhi batas 0–90° bila ada repair meniskus

Slide the heel towards the buttock as tolerated; respect the 0–90° limit after meniscal repair

keterangan.id:
**Bridge**
Angkat panggul dengan gluteus; panggul tetap rata, tanpa nyeri lutut

Lift the pelvis using the glutes; keep the pelvis level, no knee pain
keterangan.zh:
**臀桥**
用臀肌抬起骨盆；骨盆保持水平，膝关节无痛
keterangan.uz:
**Bridge**

butir.id: **0–4 mgg:** menapak parsial 20 kg; ROM 0–90° dengan brace
butir.en: **0–4 wk:** partial weight-bearing 20 kg; ROM 0–90° in a brace
butir.zh: **0–4周：**部分负重 20 kg；佩戴支具，活动度 0–90°
butir.uz: **0–4 hafta:** qisman tayanish 20 kg; ortezda ROM 0–90°

butir.id: **4–6 mgg:** menapak sesuai toleransi; brace hingga minggu 6
butir.en: **4–6 wk:** weight-bearing as tolerated; brace until week 6
butir.zh: **4–6周：**可耐受负重；支具佩戴至第6周

butir.id: **3–4 bln:** penguatan berbeban dari bulan 3; hindari fleksi dalam berbeban hingga ± 4 bulan
butir.en: **3–4 mo:** loaded strengthening from month 3; avoid loaded deep flexion until ~4 months
butir.zh: **3–4个月：**第3个月起负重力量训练；约4个月内避免负重深屈
butir.uz: **3–4 oy:** 3-oydan yuklamali kuch mashqlari; ~4 oygacha yuklama bilan chuqur fleksiyadan saqlaning

butir.zh: **4–6个月：**对抗性及竞技运动（单纯修复）
butir.uz: **4–6 oy:** kontaktli va musobaqa sporti (izolyatsiyalangan tikish)

butir.zh: **>6周：**逐步负重至完全负重

butir.id: **4–5 bln:** penguatan berbeban ditunda 1 bulan dibanding repair stabil
butir.en: **4–5 mo:** loaded strengthening delayed by 1 month compared with stable repair
butir.zh: **4–5个月：**负重力量训练较稳定型修复推迟1个月
butir.uz: **4–5 oy:** yuklamali kuch mashqlari barqaror tikishga nisbatan 1 oyga kechiktiriladi

butir.zh: **约9个月：**职业对抗性/旋转类运动

teks.id:
**RCT, 60 pasien, repair vertikal terisolasi:** rehab bebas (2 minggu ROM 0–90°, lalu tanpa batasan) tidak meningkatkan kegagalan dibanding rehab terbatas 6 minggu (28% vs 36% tidak/parsial sembuh) [13]
**Tinjauan sistematis:** ROM dini dan menapak segera tampak tidak merugikan; belum ada konsensus protokol ideal [11][12]
teks.en:
**RCT, 60 patients, isolated vertical repair:** free rehab (2 weeks ROM 0–90°, then unrestricted) did not increase failure compared with 6 weeks of restricted rehab (28% vs 36% not/partially healed) [13]
**Systematic reviews:** early ROM and immediate weight-bearing do not appear harmful; there is no consensus on the ideal protocol [11][12]
teks.zh:
**RCT，60例，单纯垂直撕裂修复：**自由康复（2周内活动度 0–90°，之后不限制）与限制性康复6周相比，失败率未增加（未愈合/部分愈合 28% vs 36%）[13]
**系统评价：**早期活动度训练和立即负重似乎无害；理想方案尚无共识 [11][12]
teks.uz:
**RCT, 60 bemor, izolyatsiyalangan vertikal tikish:** erkin reabilitatsiya (2 hafta ROM 0–90°, keyin cheklovsiz) 6 haftalik cheklangan reabilitatsiyaga nisbatan muvaffaqiyatsizlikni oshirmagan (bitmagan/qisman bitgan 28% va 36%) [13]
**Tizimli sharhlar:** erta ROM va darhol tayanish zararli emasga oʻxshaydi; ideal protokol boʻyicha konsensus yoʻq [11][12]

keterangan.id:
**Split squat**

**Split squat**
Controlled descent; the front knee does not collapse inwards

**分腿蹲**

keterangan.uz:

**Single-leg RDL**

keterangan.uz:

keterangan.uz:

**Single-leg squat**
Kedalaman sebatas kontrol; lutut segaris jari kaki
keterangan.en:
**Single-leg squat**
Depth only as far as control allows; knee in line with the toes
keterangan.zh:
**单腿深蹲**
下蹲深度以能控制为限；膝关节与足尖对齐
keterangan.uz:
**Single-leg squat**
Chuqurlik nazorat doirasida; tizza oyoq barmoqlari bilan bir chiziqda

judul.en: Limb Symmetry Index (LSI): How to Measure
judul.zh: 肢体对称指数（LSI）：如何测量

pesan.zh: 80 跑步 · 90 比赛 · 100 旋转

teks.id:
Persentase kemampuan kaki yang cedera dibanding kaki yang sehat pada tes yang sama.
**Tes jarak, tinggi, kekuatan:** cedera ÷ sehat × 100%
**Tes waktu (6-m timed hop):** sehat ÷ cedera × 100%
teks.en:
The injured leg's performance as a percentage of the healthy leg's on the same test.
**Distance, height, strength tests:** injured ÷ healthy × 100%
**Timed tests (6-m timed hop):** healthy ÷ injured × 100%
teks.zh:
同一测试中患侧能力占健侧能力的百分比。
**距离、高度、力量测试：**患侧 ÷ 健侧 × 100%
**计时测试（6 m 计时单腿跳）：**健侧 ÷ 患侧 × 100%
teks.uz:
Bir xil testda jarohatlangan oyoq imkoniyatining sogʻlom oyoqqa nisbatan foizi.
**Masofa, balandlik, kuch testlari:** jarohatlangan ÷ sogʻlom × 100%
**Vaqt testlari (6-m timed hop):** sogʻlom ÷ jarohatlangan × 100%

butir.zh: **力量**——股四头肌和腘绳肌：60°/s 等速测试或测力计
butir.uz: **Kuch** — kvadritseps va hamstring: izokinetik 60°/s yoki dinamometr

butir.uz: **Hop test** — single hop, triple hop, crossover hop (masofa); 6-m timed hop (vaqt)

butir.uz: **Sakrash** — countermovement va drop jump: balandlik va impuls

teks.id: Pakai alat, posisi, sudut dan kecepatan yang sama; catat nilai mentah kedua kaki, bukan hanya persentasenya.
teks.en: Use the same device, position, angle and speed; record the raw values of both legs, not just the percentage.
teks.zh: 使用相同的设备、体位、角度和速度；记录双侧原始数值，而不只是百分比。
teks.uz: Bir xil asbob, holat, burchak va tezlikdan foydalaning; faqat foizni emas, ikkala oyoqning xom qiymatlarini yozib qoʻying.

teks.en: Example: 80 kg ÷ 100 kg × 100% = 80%

teks.id: Kaki cedera saat ini ÷ kaki sehat sebelum operasi. Butuh data tes pra-operasi.
teks.en: Current injured leg ÷ healthy leg before surgery. Requires pre-operative test data.
teks.zh: 当前患侧 ÷ 术前健侧。需要术前测试数据。
teks.uz: Hozirgi jarohatlangan oyoq ÷ operatsiyadan oldingi sogʻlom oyoq. Operatsiyadan oldingi test maʼlumotlari kerak.

teks.uz: **ACLR dan 6 oy oʻtib barcha testlardan oʻtgan bemorlar (n = 70)**

teks.id: Kaki sehat ikut melemah selama rehabilitasi, sehingga LSI tampak tinggi padahal kedua kaki sama-sama lemah.
teks.en: The healthy leg also weakens during rehabilitation, so the LSI looks high even though both legs are weak.
teks.zh: 康复期间健侧腿也会变弱，因此即使双腿都弱，LSI 看起来仍然很高。
teks.uz: Reabilitatsiya davomida sogʻlom oyoq ham zaiflashadi, shuning uchun ikkala oyoq ham zaif boʻlsa-da, LSI yuqori koʻrinadi.

teks.zh: 在场地上进行专项动作，强度递增
teks.uz: Maydonda sport harakatlari, intensivlik oshadi

teks.id: Situasi laga, kondisi lelah, kontak

judul.en: The order must not be reversed.

teks.id: Kuasai gerakan terencana sebelum gerakan reaktif yang tak terduga.
teks.en: Master planned movements before unpredictable reactive ones.
teks.zh: 先掌握预设动作，再进行不可预知的反应性动作。
teks.uz: Kutilmagan reaktiv harakatlardan oldin rejalashtirilgan harakatlarni oʻzlashtiring.

teks.id: Naikkan intensitas hanya bila lutut tetap tenang keesokan harinya dan kualitas gerak terjaga.
teks.en: Increase intensity only if the knee stays calm the next day and movement quality is maintained.
teks.zh: 仅在次日膝关节仍保持安定且动作质量良好时才增加强度。
teks.uz: Intensivlikni faqat ertasi kuni tizza tinch qolsa va harakat sifati saqlansa oshiring.

judul.id: Lari, Lompat, dan Mendarat dengan Aman

pesan.uz: Yumshoq qoʻning, tizza barmoqlar bilan bir chiziqda

keterangan.id:
**Lari interval**
Mulai dengan interval jalan–lari; naikkan bila lutut tetap tenang keesokan hari
keterangan.en:
**Interval running**
Start with walk–run intervals; progress if the knee stays calm the next day
keterangan.zh:
**间歇跑**
从走跑交替开始；次日膝关节仍安定时再进阶
keterangan.uz:
**Intervalli yugurish**
Yurish–yugurish intervallaridan boshlang; ertasi kuni tizza tinch qolsa, oshiring

keterangan.id:
**Pogo satu kaki**
Kontak singkat dan ringan di telapak depan; tanpa nyeri
keterangan.en:
**Single-leg pogo**
Short, light contacts on the forefoot; pain-free
keterangan.zh:
**单腿弹跳（pogo）**
前脚掌短促轻触地；无痛
keterangan.uz:
**Bir oyoqda pogo**
Oyoq old qismida qisqa va yengil tegish; ogʻriqsiz

keterangan.id:
**Drop landing**
Mendarat lembut dua kaki; lutut dan panggul menekuk, lutut tidak jatuh ke dalam
keterangan.en:
**Drop landing**
Land softly on both feet; knees and hips bend, knees do not collapse inwards
keterangan.zh:
**跳落着地**
双脚轻柔落地；屈膝屈髋，膝关节不内扣
keterangan.uz:
**Drop landing**
Ikki oyoqqa yumshoq qoʻning; tizza va son bukiladi, tizza ichkariga tushmaydi

keterangan.id:
**Hop & stick**
Lompat ke depan satu kaki, tahan pendaratan 2–3 detik
keterangan.en:
**Hop & stick**
Hop forward on one leg, hold the landing for 2–3 seconds
keterangan.zh:
**单腿跳停**
单腿向前跳，落地后保持 2–3 秒
keterangan.uz:
**Hop & stick**
Bir oyoqda oldinga sakrang, qoʻnishni 2–3 soniya ushlab turing

teks.id: Kaki merah = kaki yang dioperasi; angka di kiri atas = fleksi lutut kaki tersebut.
teks.en: Red leg = operated leg; the number at top left = knee flexion of that leg.
teks.zh: 红色腿＝手术侧；左上角数字＝该侧膝关节屈曲角度。
teks.uz: Qizil oyoq — operatsiya qilingan oyoq; chap yuqoridagi raqam — shu oyoq tizzasining fleksiyasi.
